Explanation of ara::com API
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
Note: Equal to the Proxy class the interfaces the Skeleton class has to provide are
defined by
ara::com
, a generic (product independent) generator could generate an
abstract class or a mock class against which the application developer could implement
his service provider application. This perfectly suits the platform vendor independent
development of Adaptive AUTOSAR SWCs.
ara::com
expects skeleton related artifacts inside a namespace "skeleton". This
namespace is typically included in a namespace hierarchy deduced from the service
definition and its context.
